title: Edge Machine Learning for Predictive Maintenance of Industrial Sensor Networks
hypothesis: Multi-modal edge ML models can detect impending equipment failures with ≥10 days lead time and reduce energy consumption by ≥15% compared with reactive maintenance baselines.
limitations: Acoustic modality underperformed in isolation (EXP-PM-006) due to limited labeled data
All tests conducted on synthetic and controlled industrial sensor streams; field generalization requires further study
Energy savings estimated from duty-cycle reduction models, not continuous power metering

anomalies.description: Acoustic-only model F1 0.71 significantly below multi-modal peers; high false positive rate 0.14
